title.rendered: Xech- Tellivibe Max II Bluetooth Speaker

content.rendered:
Xech- Tellivibe Max Bluetooth Speaker

TURN YOUR SMARTPHONE INTO A 90s RETRO MINI TV WITH SPEAKER

XECH Tellivibe Max is an innovative Bluetooth speaker with a smartphone holder and a retro radio design that allows you to go hands-free as you immerse yourself & enjoy your favourite shows & movies.

Introducing XECH Tellivibe Max! A 5W Mini Bluetooth Speaker with a Phone Holder to take your hands-free entertainment to the MAX! Simply connect your smartphone and slide it in and enjoy an immersive handsfree viewing experience.

AUDIOSYNTH TECHNOLOGY

High fidelity speakers & a high performance chipset that creates the perfect balance between Bass & Treble to delivery crisp & pure sound! XECH TELLIVIBE MAX is designed to make handsfree entertainment better!

NON STOP ENTERTAINMENT ON THE GO

XECH Tellivibe Max comes with a massive battery backup that’s perfect to watch your favourite shows & series back to back! Talk about finishing an entire season in a go!

LIGHT WEIGHT PORTABLE DESIGN

XECH Tellivibe Max has a clean minimalist look with a dash of retro ! A truly Portable Speaker that comes with a handle that allows you to carry it just about anywhere!

  • MOQ- 100 Pcs.
  • Printing, GST & Delivery charges will be charged extra.
